description: Main entry script for openclaw project, handling version checks, module loading, error handling, and CLI invocation logic.

methods.name: parseNodeVersion
methods.description: Parses the Node.js version string into major and minor components.

methods.name: isSupportedNodeVersion
methods.description: Checks if the current Node.js version meets minimum requirements.

methods.name: ensureSupportedNodeVersion
methods.description: Verifies Node.js version and exits if not supported.

methods.name: isModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Determines if an error is a module not found error.

methods.name: isDirectModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Checks if a module not found error matches a specific specifier.

methods.name: installProcessWarningFilter
methods.description: Attempts to load and install a process warning filter.

methods.name: tryImport
methods.description: Attempts to dynamically import a module and handles not found errors.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a file specified by a URL exists.

methods.name: buildMissingEntryErrorMessage
methods.description: Builds error message when required build artifacts are missing.

methods.name: isBareRootHelpInvocation
methods.description: Determines if CLI is invoked with help flags.

methods.name: loadPrecomputedRootHelpText
methods.description: Loads precomputed help text from JSON file.

methods.name: tryOutputBareRootHelp
methods.description: Attempts to output help information based on CLI invocation.
